name: gizza-ai/images-to-pdf
summary: Combine images into a single PDF (one image per page).

tool.description: Combine a set of images into a single PDF, one image per page, in the given order. Each image is a URL or a `ref` to an uploaded image attachment (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP). Provide at least one image.

images.description: Ordered list of image sources (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP). Each item has exactly one of `url` or `ref`. One image per PDF page, in order.

url.description: URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
